title: Connect to Amazon RDS from AWS Lambda
description: This snippet demonstrates how to connect to an Amazon RDS database from an AWS Lambda function with IAM authentication. It connects directly to the RDS instance or cluster endpoint and does not require an RDS Proxy. This snippet is valid for MariaDB/MySQL or Aurora for MySQL

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) is a collection of managed services that makes it simple to set up, operate, and scale databases in the cloud. Choose from seven popular engines. Connect to an RDS database using IAM authentication.

codeTabs.title: Copy the code into your Lambda function
codeTabs.description: Follow the AWS Lambda instructions for packaging with dependencies and uploading in .zip format. This snippet uses the go mysql driver
